name: Oregon House Honorary Page Program
org: Office of the Chief Clerk of the Oregon House
what_you_do: Honorary pages work on the House floor. They help with the daily work of the Oregon legislature at the State Capitol.
who_can_apply: Any student ages 12 to 17 in good standing at school.
pay_detail: Free. Travel and parking are not reimbursed.
duration: Honorary page sessions are scheduled on legislative days. The page does not give hours.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. The application asks for a first, second and third choice of dates. The page does not say whether applications are open.
how_to_apply: Fill out the application on the Chief Clerk page with your first, second and third choice of dates.
notes: The page asks students to be in good academic standing. The same page lists a 2027 college internship program (not this card).
